arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِنّا أَرسَلنا نوحًا إِلىٰ قَومِهِ أَن أَنذِر قَومَكَ مِن قَبلِ أَن يَأتِيَهُم عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
transliteration: Inna arsalna noohan ila qawmihi an anthir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum AAathabun aleemun
translation: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them

arabic: قالَ يٰقَومِ إِنّى لَكُم نَذيرٌ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Qala ya qawmi innee lakum natheerun mubeenun
translation: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you

arabic: أَنِ اعبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقوهُ وَأَطيعونِ
transliteration: Ani oAAbudoo Allaha waittaqoohu waateeAAooni
translation: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me

arabic: يَغفِر لَكُم مِن ذُنوبِكُم وَيُؤَخِّركُم إِلىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ إِذا جاءَ لا يُؤَخَّرُ لَو كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala Allahi itha jaa la yuakhkharu law kuntum taAAlamoona
translation: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ إِنّى دَعَوتُ قَومى لَيلًا وَنَهارًا
transliteration: Qala rabbi innee daAAawtu qawmee laylan wanaharan
translation: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day

arabic: فَلَم يَزِدهُم دُعاءى إِلّا فِرارًا
transliteration: Falam yazidhum duAAaee illa firaran
translation: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance

arabic: وَإِنّى كُلَّما دَعَوتُهُم لِتَغفِرَ لَهُم جَعَلوا أَصٰبِعَهُم فى ءاذانِهِم وَاستَغشَوا ثِيابَهُم وَأَصَرّوا وَاستَكبَرُوا استِكبارًا
transliteration: Wainnee kullama daAAawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaAAaloo asabiAAahum fee athanihim waistaghshaw thiyabahum waasarroo waistakbaroo istikbaran
translation: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنّى دَعَوتُهُم جِهارًا
transliteration: Thumma innee daAAawtuhum jiharan
translation: And lo! I have called unto them aloud

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنّى أَعلَنتُ لَهُم وَأَسرَرتُ لَهُم إِسرارًا
transliteration: Thumma innee aAAlantu lahum waasrartu lahum israran
translation: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private

arabic: فَقُلتُ استَغفِروا رَبَّكُم إِنَّهُ كانَ غَفّارًا
transliteration: Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffaran
translation: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving

arabic: يُرسِلِ السَّماءَ عَلَيكُم مِدرارًا
transliteration: Yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran
translation: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain

arabic: وَيُمدِدكُم بِأَموٰلٍ وَبَنينَ وَيَجعَل لَكُم جَنّٰتٍ وَيَجعَل لَكُم أَنهٰرًا
transliteration: Wayumdidkum biamwalin wabaneena wayajAAal lakum jannatin wayajAAal lakum anharan
translation: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers

arabic: ما لَكُم لا تَرجونَ لِلَّهِ وَقارًا
transliteration: Ma lakum la tarjoona lillahi waqaran
translation: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity

arabic: وَقَد خَلَقَكُم أَطوارًا
transliteration: Waqad khalaqakum atwaran
translation: When He created you by (divers) stages

arabic: أَلَم تَرَوا كَيفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِباقًا
transliteration: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa Allahu sabAAa samawatin tibaqan
translation: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony

arabic: وَجَعَلَ القَمَرَ فيهِنَّ نورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمسَ سِراجًا
transliteration: WajaAAala alqamara feehinna nooran wajaAAala alshshamsa sirajan
translation: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp

arabic: وَاللَّهُ أَنبَتَكُم مِنَ الأَرضِ نَباتًا
transliteration: WaAllahu anbatakum mina alardi nabatan
translation: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth

arabic: ثُمَّ يُعيدُكُم فيها وَيُخرِجُكُم إِخراجًا
transliteration: Thumma yuAAeedukum feeha wayukhrijukum ikhrajan
translation: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing

arabic: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الأَرضَ بِساطًا
transliteration: WaAllahu jaAAala lakumu alarda bisatan
translation: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you

arabic: لِتَسلُكوا مِنها سُبُلًا فِجاجًا
transliteration: Litaslukoo minha subulan fijajan
translation: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof

arabic: قالَ نوحٌ رَبِّ إِنَّهُم عَصَونى وَاتَّبَعوا مَن لَم يَزِدهُ مالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلّا خَسارًا
transliteration: Qala noohun rabbi innahum AAasawnee waittabaAAoo man lam yazidhu maluhu wawaladuhu illa khasaran
translation: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin

arabic: وَمَكَروا مَكرًا كُبّارًا
transliteration: Wamakaroo makran kubbaran
translation: And they have plotted a mighty plot

arabic: وَقالوا لا تَذَرُنَّ ءالِهَتَكُم وَلا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلا سُواعًا وَلا يَغوثَ وَيَعوقَ وَنَسرًا
transliteration: Waqaloo la tatharunna alihatakum wala tatharunna waddan wala suwaAAan wala yaghootha wayaAAooqa wanasran
translation: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr

arabic: وَقَد أَضَلّوا كَثيرًا وَلا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمينَ إِلّا ضَلٰلًا
transliteration: Waqad adalloo katheeran wala tazidi alththalimeena illa dalalan
translation: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error

arabic: مِمّا خَطيـٰٔتِهِم أُغرِقوا فَأُدخِلوا نارًا فَلَم يَجِدوا لَهُم مِن دونِ اللَّهِ أَنصارًا
transliteration: Mimma khateeatihim oghriqoo faodkhiloo naran falam yajidoo lahum min dooni Allahi ansaran
translation: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah

arabic: وَقالَ نوحٌ رَبِّ لا تَذَر عَلَى الأَرضِ مِنَ الكٰفِرينَ دَيّارًا
transliteration: Waqala noohun rabbi la tathar AAala alardi mina alkafireena dayyaran
translation: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land

arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرهُم يُضِلّوا عِبادَكَ وَلا يَلِدوا إِلّا فاجِرًا كَفّارًا
transliteration: Innaka in tatharhum yudilloo AAibadaka wala yalidoo illa fajiran kaffaran
translation: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates

arabic: رَبِّ اغفِر لى وَلِوٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيتِىَ مُؤمِنًا وَلِلمُؤمِنينَ وَالمُؤمِنٰتِ وَلا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمينَ إِلّا تَبارًا
transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muminan walilmumineena waalmuminati wala tazidi alththalimeena illa tabaran
translation: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin
